threshold_rule: logit_fg-logit_bg > log(tau/(1-tau)); tie background; threshold after output interpolation
primary: per sensor event-equal absolute relative extent error; GT-zero excluded with count
smoothing: within minimum plus1pp; closest to0.5 then larger tau
secondary: per sensor pooled F1 maximum; exact ties closest0.5 then larger tau
global_event_aggregation: sum S1/S2 confusion counts within event before event equal aggregation
